definitions.gloss: bare feet; barefoot; without socks or stockings
definitions.explanation: Feet without any covering such as socks, stockings, or shoes. In Japanese culture, being barefoot indoors is common, but going barefoot outdoors or in formal situations is notable.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{素足|すあし}にサンダルが{気持|きも}ちいい。
examples.english: In summer, sandals on bare feet feel nice.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{素足|すあし}で{砂浜|すなはま}を{駆|か}け{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: The children were running around the sandy beach barefoot.

notes:
USAGE:
{素足|すあし} refers specifically to feet without socks or stockings. It can be used adverbially with the particle で ({素足|すあし}で = barefoot).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素足|すあし}で{歩|ある}く (to walk barefoot)
- {素足|すあし}にサンダル (sandals on bare feet)
- {素足|すあし}のまま (still barefoot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{裸足|はだし} also means barefoot but emphasizes having no shoes at all. {素足|すあし} specifically means without socks or stockings, and can include wearing shoes directly on bare feet.
